# Elora Electrical CAD Library

> Open catalogue of official manufacturer CAD/BIM sources for switchboards, switchgear, switchrooms, generators and microgrids. USA, Australia, UK and Europe have equal research priority. CAD download rights are recorded per file.

## Canonical website

- [Search and download](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/cad-library): free engineering tool.
- [Full live JSON](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/cad-library/catalogue.json?all=1): source of truth, including stable site download URLs.
- [Live OpenAPI](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/cad-library/openapi.json): search filters and download endpoints.
- [Coverage](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/cad-library/coverage): collection gaps and limitations.

- [Live entry Markdown](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/cad-library/entries/victron-energy-cerbo-gx.md): example of an exact equipment text export; replace the ID for other entries.
- [Live entry JSON](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/cad-library/entries/victron-energy-cerbo-gx.json): matching structured facts and references.
- [GA equipment references](https://eloragrid.ai/objects): related equipment concepts and product references.
- [Drawing guides](https://eloragrid.ai/tools/electrical-library/guides): how to read electrical drawings.

## Repository resources

- [Agent guide](docs/agents.md): field interpretation, rights and checksum handling.
- [Catalogue JSON](data/catalogue.json): complete public snapshot.
- [Equipment CSV](data/catalogue.csv): one row per source.
- [Files CSV](data/files.csv): one row per listed file, original and delivery checksums.
- [Equipment directory](equipment/README.md): readable entry pages with equipment facts, file-selection guidance, preview-image links, GA references and provenance.
- [Schema](schema/catalogue.schema.json): public record structure.
- [Manifest](data/manifest.json): snapshot counts and content hashes.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): missing sources, revisions and rights corrections.
- [Licence scope](LICENSE.md): CC BY 4.0 metadata, MIT code, separate manufacturer CAD rights.

Family archives and manufacturer portals are not exact configured products. Global discovery tags do not establish certification. Unknown rights remain unknown. Use stable Elora downloadUrl values, not temporary signed attachment links. Contact/request data is private.

Prefer each entry’s canonicalUrl for citations and the live feed for current availability. Preview images remain website links; this repository does not contain model binaries. The source audit covers an older source-register subset; the manifest counts the complete expanded catalogue.
